pins.name: D29/A3
pins.label: D29/A3 (GPIO29)
pins.notes: PIN_BAT_ADC — wired to the onboard Li-po battery connector's voltage-divider ADC input. analogRead(A3) reads a proportion of the battery voltage when a battery is connected; still usable as a general GPIO/PWM pin otherwise.
